component.name: SoloMD
component.summary: Native-fast, local-first Markdown editor and personal knowledge vault

description.p: SoloMD is a lightweight, local-first Markdown editor built on Rust and Tauri 2. Your notes live as plain .md files on disk with zero telemetry, no mandatory cloud account, and instant startup.

ul.li: WYSIWYG Live Edit, Split Preview, Source Mode, and distraction-free Reading Mode
Unified Export Center for PDF (with bookmarks and TOC page), Word (.docx), HTML, EPUB, ODT, LaTeX, RTF, PNG, and TextBundle
Built-in KaTeX math, Mermaid and PlantUML diagrams, and embedded tldraw whiteboards
Local-first Git, WebDAV, and cloud-folder synchronization with optional E2E encryption
Built-in MCP server and BYOK / local AI assistant (Ollama, LM Studio, llama.cpp, OPR)

description.p: Unified Export Center (#572), Pure WYSIWYG mode (#303), Open Provider Registry (OPR) local AI auto-discovery (#286), and lightweight user extensions (#173).
